name: BookLeaf - Author Royalty Notification & Summary System

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  author_id: $json.author_id,
  author_name: $json.author_name,
  author_email: $json.author_email,
  sent_at: $json.sent_at,
  status: $json.status,
  email_subject: $json.email_subject,
  email_body: $json.email_body,
  trigger_type: $json.trigger_type,
  error_message: $json.error_message || ''
}) }}
